column1: # Sky-position regression corpus for the direction cascade: the
# canonical high-PM set (tier-1 Gaia) plus Sirius/Vega for tier 2
# (hip2_saturated, the Gaia-saturated bright set).
# Positions are at the J2016.0 scene epoch (CATALOG_SCENE_EPOCH):
# - Gaia tier: the raw Gaia DR3 catalog ra/dec, whose native epoch IS
#   J2016.0 — so the cascade's propagation is a Δt=0 no-op here. These
#   rows therefore pin source-id selection, tier routing, and xyz
#   assembly (a wrong source or a sign flip shows up as tens of arcsec),
#   NOT the propagation formula. That formula (PM sign / cos delta /
#   Δt direction) is exercised by the 24.75-yr HIP2 tier below and
#   pinned independently against SIMBAD J2000 in direction-cascade.test.ts.
# - Sirius/Vega (tier 2): van-Leeuwen-2007 J1991.25 PM-propagated 24.75
#   yr forward to J2016.0 — this DOES exercise the propagation.
# - xi UMa: WAS the tier-3 (athyg_printed) pin, at AT-HYG's printed
#   ~J2000 coord, because its spine row resolved no Gaia source. The
#   backfilled source_id now reaches a Gaia row, so it routes tier 1 as a
#   2p (position-only) anchor and this row pins that Gaia J2016.0 coord.
#   The move is worth ~11" of staleness: its 730 mas/yr over the 16 yr
#   from J2000 is exactly what the printed cell was NOT propagating.
#   The 2p fit is blended (ipd_frac_multi_peak 24 on a ~2" pair), so the
#   coord is the pair photocentre rather than A alone — good to ~1",
#   which is why it stays looser than the 0.5" Gaia rows above.
# lookup: hip where the AT-HYG row carries one. xi UMa's spine row
# carries no HIP of its own, so it is addressed by proper name and its
# hip cell is blank.
# total_pm_masyr is the published total proper motion (mas/yr). The
# current-epoch velocity test advances the star's BAKED J2016 position +
# BAKED vx/vy/vz through the same epoch-advance-pure function the runtime
# uses and checks the on-sky angular displacement equals total_pm × Δt —
# validating end-to-end that catalog.bin's space-motion velocity reproduces
# the star's real proper motion (a wrong tier / distance-scale / unit / sign
# would miss badly at a 34 yr baseline). Blank = skip (velocity magnitude
# not pinned for that row).
